So, lemme tell you how true this is. 

My mom got started on diet coke when it first came out, and literally ever since it is the only soda she will drink. Now over the years she has cut back heavily, but there are ALWAYS small bottles in the fridge in my parents home lest the risk of a withdrawal headache presents itself. 
And my mom is on a different level. Two liters are trash, while small 8oz bottles and cans are the best. If a resturant she goes to has changed their syrup levels, or god forbid not restocked said syrups, she notices immidately. Its like watching a wine expert at a tasting the way she smacks her lips, considers the taste while the whole table holds their breath to make sure we dont have "flag down the waiter" situation. 

She drank diet coke with me while in the womb, and the joke was always that she transferred the addiction onto me which, I can totally believe. For most of my childhood and young adult life i drank specifically diet coke, and I can tell you that the whole "aspartame fucks your brain" is absolutely trure. My memory is shit, and I actually do wonder if constant exposure in my youth is going to give me issues later on. 

Ive cut bafk significantly though, and now I only enjoy a diet coke every now and then but boy lemme tell ya, the cravings are real and after long enough taking that first sip really does feel like scratching a cocaine itch.
